description: HazardHunterPH is a data repository run by Mines and Geosciences Bureau, Philippines. HazardHunterPH is a web tool that gives a quick hazard assessment for a point in the Philippines: ground shaking, liquefaction, landslide, flood, storm surge, tsunami and volcanic hazards, drawn from national geohazard maps. Coverage: Philippines. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as viewer, pdf; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("HazardHunterPH - Hazard assessment at your fingertips") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support hazard exposure screening of sites and facilities in the Philippines. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
